steps.name: An Uninvited Visitor
steps.objective: Find out what happened to [Medea], then turn in the quest to [Medea].

lines.text: (Deep inside Kali, a figure continues speaking from within a thick darkness only Medea can see.)
I had hoped you would stay out of this.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know why you kept me by your side. But when I discovered I had a name other than Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I began to resent you. Those hazy memories I recovered from the abyss where you imprisoned them...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I believed there was a reason for those memories, and for your disappearance. I no longer do.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You abandoned your responsibilities as leader of the Kali tribe. That alone is reason enough. You watched everything as I led our people here, though I was only a child.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You even impersonated me while I was away... You abandoned us. Why come back now? This isn't the night you've been waiting for. Why?!
To have my way, child.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You will not get what you want.
Child, is that any way to address me...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea? Who are you talking to...? Why is it dark just here?
(The figure in the darkness seems surprised at the sound of %s calling to Medea.)
How curious. You can see this darkness and hear my voice...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're...?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (%s slowly tightens their grip on their weapon.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, step back.
Child, I have no further business here today. I shall leave.
Adventurer, I do not know what form our next meeting will take...
But let me show you him.
(The thick darkness surrounding the woman swells until it swallows everyone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what? What's this...?
(Some of the darkness disperses, revealing an unfamiliar place. Through a dense sandy haze, structures lie buried among enormous dunes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where am I? And that person...)
(A man stands alone amid the relentless, sand-laden wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's Weiss... Which means this is Avalon?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Everything is ready. Am I the only one left...?
(Weiss slowly surveys his surroundings, seemingly untroubled by %s's arrival.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can't he see me?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: All that remains is the key...
(Weiss senses something amiss and looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...He hasn't noticed me, has he?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Was it my imagination?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: So much has happened. I felt this way when I first came here, too...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The day you long for will never come. I have wished for this moment, and I will never back down...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: So it wasn't my imagination.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The witch is playing tricks.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I am ready to open the door. I shall be waiting. Adventurer of the goddess... Come to Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He saw me...!! Huh?)
(As their eyes meet, faint, unfamiliar memories flow into %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explosions, one after another...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A strange door is opening. Beings from another world are emerging, wishing for this world's destruction...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone is crying, holding people as they die...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Another world, somewhere far from here, is disappearing...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Th-that place...)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I shall tell you. That is Azrael... Now the world the goddess loved will share its fate.

lines.speaker: 메디아의 목소리
lines.text: (Wake up, %s!!)

steps.name: Iris and Medea
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」, then find the place in 「Deborah Snowfield」 that was sealed. Meet 「Frozen」, enter 「Burning Wheel」, and turn in the quest to [Shynic].

lines.text: (At the sound of Medea's voice, the vision of Avalon dissolves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Why am I... Medea? When I arrived, there was... that person... Wait, why was I crying?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You saw something, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I think someone came to see you...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why come now?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It isn't what you're thinking.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She came to persuade me not to go to Avalon. When she realized she couldn't, she left.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She will not intervene in our confrontation with Weiss. She has her own 'role' to play.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The witch's role...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Let's go. We have little time. Lady Iris is calling us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Oh...
(A breeze, as warm as Iris's touch, blows in from somewhere and nestles against %s.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Come with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...
(The warm breeze guides them to a place where beautiful flower petals dance through the air.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So this is where Lady Iris stays.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. This is where I can meet her.
(As %s speaks, Iris greets them both with a radiant smile.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome, Medea, %s.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's a pleasure to see you, Lady Iris. Now that I think about it...
(Medea looks at Iris with a small smile.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So this is how it feels, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And you wanted to keep someone like her all to yourself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I wasn't trying to... I mean, that's not...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Don't look so flustered. I'm joking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Joking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Medea, really... Wait, Medea is joking?!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hehe. Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. I know it can't have been easy, but you made that decision for everyone's sake...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please, don't thank me. That power wasn't entirely mine. I merely returned a portion of it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you sure you're all right with the choice you've made...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As I said, I'm all right. I still don't know how to rid myself of the half that remains...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But I intend to keep trying, so I won't lose everyone...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (And so I won't lose myself... Lady Iris, even if I take another form, please...)
(Iris nods quietly, and Medea smiles faintly in return.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Now that we've said our greetings, I'll send you both to the Debora Snowfields.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's finally sinking in. We're going to Avalon...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s... I'm sorry to entrust such a difficult task to you, %s. What you saw in Avalon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm doing this for you, Iris, and for everyone. Because I want to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The more I discover, the more you'll learn, too. And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are things I want Weiss to tell me. So don't worry too much, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah... I can feel cracks in the Great Wall. I'll stay here and hold them back as best I can.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then we'll be on our way, Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, Medea. Now, please close your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, Iris...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The Debora Snowfields...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's snowy, but it feels refreshing rather than cold.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps because Io has protected this land for so long. Otherwise, it might have been devastated like everywhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're probably right.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's someone over there... He seems to be waiting for us. A Demigod...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...A Demigod?
(A man spots Medea and %s arriving deep in the Debora Snowfields and waves.)
Medea and %s... right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you... Frozen, by any chance?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: That's me. Frozen. And you're %s... I've heard a lot about you. Nice to meet you.
(Frozen offers his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nice to meet you, too.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I hope you don't mind if I speak casually with you, %s?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: As for you, Medea, I'll address you as I would the other Champions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I don't mind.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Good. We haven't much time, so let's head inside.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: We've connected the Debora Snowfields to another place. The others are waiting there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's hurry.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shall we, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So the others have arrived already. Very well. This place must be...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Yes. The place Shynic prepared... Follow me.
(Frozen leads the way, and the two follow. Soon the white snowfields begin to darken with an unfathomable chaos.)
(After a brief moment, the darkness around them starts to fade, revealing a sight unlike anything they have seen before.)
(A starry night stretches endlessly before them, with bars erected to prevent anyone from leaving.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This doesn't seem to be our world. But it isn't another world, either...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It must be the boundary between them. The Great Wall...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You two, head that way. Shynic is waiting. I'll make another patrol of Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't it dangerous to go alone?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren is coming with me. I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, wait. I've heard that name somewhere...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren is Ziskad's third disciple, and now my attendant as well. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I'll see you all later.
(As though she has noticed Frozen leaving, a girl carrying an enormous scythe steps forward from further inside.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Found a funny face! ♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, this place is your...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Shh, Medea. Let me tell them. Hehe. Bring %s and that silly expression over here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, I think I'm fine here...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The floor there is weak. It could break and drop you any second.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But if you'd like to drift who knows where, neither truly alive nor truly dead, feel free to stay there. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah! Help!

steps.name: The Wheel That Will Not Turn (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Shynic] and [Valdrick] in 「Burning Wheel」. Then turn in the quest to [Io].

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As mischievous as ever, Shynic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? If she's being mischievous, then...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just kidding. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-you scared me!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, save your shock for later. Look at Valdrick climbing up through the floor over there.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: ...Whew. The floor gave way. Thought I was going to die.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When I designed this place, I figured it couldn't kill me, so I cut a few corners. That happens sometimes.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't worry. There aren't any more spots like that. You shouldn't doubt the girl who built Tartaros all by herself. ♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, is this that place from long ago? When Adrica shook...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a sort of prison. I was thinking of ways to make the old man who cursed me suffer, and looking for somewhere to lock him up.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I went mad digging up the construction site and punched right through the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I considered burying him here, but I didn't. ♡ Aren't I good?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Very good.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: And thanks to that, you got to ▒▒ and ▒▒, which was even better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Shynic... about that...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe. If I locked him up here, he'd turn like a cog through an eternity of suffering... But that wouldn't be fun.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Besides, if his face were in here, it'd be hard to bring this place out again...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, there's something I've just taken back out, and someone to bury in here. Two birds with one stone. It would've been lovely if the flames were still burning, but they've all gone out.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, don't tell me the thing you took out is...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, don't worry about it. Burying that thing is the reason I've stayed sane all this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, what exactly is it...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a se~cret. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, if it's a se~cret, I suppose there's nothing I can do.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't worry. I won't use it on you. ♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, if you really used that on %s... it would be fatal.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: True. It really would kill you, wouldn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Please let me live.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't worry. I won't do that. Besides, the old man's helping, so it won't come to that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The old dragon is holding this place together. Avalon, here, and the Debora Snowfields. He's incredible.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So we need to give this fight everything we've got. We'll assess things here and in Avalon, then find Weiss.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm counting on you, %s. This is for everyone, for all life, and for the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, your place is after the meathead, Io, and old Ziskad. Just stand there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll take my place after I greet Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sure. We're fine for now.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Go on, %s. Say hello to everyone with Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, do we each have a 'place'?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's complicated to explain, so let's call it a Champion thing. Of course, you don't have one. ♡ If you want to become a Champion, you could kill one of...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I get it! I'll get it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. Then I'll go see Lord Atkina! Let's go, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: My little siblings! You're here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Valdrick. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Little siblings...?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You're younger than me, Medea. And %s is my little sibling, too. So that's what I'll call you both.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Very well. If that's what the Fierce King wishes...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What's this Fierce King nonsense? Call me Valdrick, or call me old man.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Well, you certainly are an old man, but I couldn't be so disrespectful... Sigh. Very well, Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Good! Let's give it our best, little siblings!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'm glad to have you with us.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Thanks to your decision, little sister Medea, we've delayed that bad guy summoning an even worse guy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A bad guy and an even worse guy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's amazing how much sense he makes...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I only did what I had to do.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's still much to do. Let's prepare here before we leave.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Good, good! It's been ages since we all cut loose together!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'll give that Weiss a proper beating!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll look forward to it.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You two, if you have a moment, how about sparring with...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, I'd nearly forgotten.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick, I'll bring you some fine meat from another continent sometime. Medea and I are going to see Lord Atkina now.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What?! Meat from another continent?! You're the best, little sibling!! I can't wait!
(Surprised at how readily Valdrick lets them leave, Medea looks at %s.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Brilliant, %s... I'm impres... Never mind. Let's go.

steps.name: The Wheel That Will Not Turn (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Io] and [Ziskad] in 「Burning Wheel」. Then turn in the quest to [Dragon Atkina].

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, Medea, welcome. I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We only saw each other recently, and you're asking already? Hehe.
(Io hugs %s, then Medea.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you for coming, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You needn't thank me, Lady Io. It's what I must...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's true for us, too. So don't worry about anything else right now. Understood?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right...
(Apparently satisfied with Medea's answer, Io smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, that's right. %s... Have you heard about the [Burning Wheel]?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a little.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Really? I suppose it wouldn't hurt to explain it again...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This is the boundary between our world and other people's worlds. Think of it as a place in between.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even as the God of the Astral Realm, Lady Iris cannot know every world. She's only just come to know our own, Eastland...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This place lies beyond her influence. That's why you, with your mental connection to her, must learn as much as you can.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The same goes for Avalon. It's in Eastland, but power from another world summoned by Weiss has corrupted it. Lady Iris can't perceive it at all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You don't look like you do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How could I not, with you explaining it so well?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, %s... Such a smooth talker. You really are something.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Io, we'll go see Lord Atkina now.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Wait, Medea? You call Shynic by her name. Why am I 'Lady Io'?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What would you like her to call you, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: She could speak casually, and perhaps call me big sister Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Everyone in the village is hundreds of years younger than me. I'd like a little sister closer to my own age.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: W-well, the age gap between us isn't exactly small, Lady Io...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: M-Medea? I'm joking. Just joking! Don't be so nervous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They're both flustered now.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go say hello to Ziskad and Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll be going as well, Lady Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: All right. We have plenty of time to talk later.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I wasn't expecting you and Medea together, %s. That makes this an even nicer surprise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Ziskad.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's been a while. I'm sorry for what happened at your estate.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's all right. You must have had a great deal on your mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? You visited his estate, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, briefly...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: She had some business with me and stopped by. %s, have you heard about the Burning Wheel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Could you tell me what's happening in Avalon?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ah, Avalon...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: There's no one there now. To be precise, no one possessing the life force of our world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It seems every living creature in Avalon has already been reduced to the power of binding. That's why I said there's nothing there.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Weiss seems to have converted every life he used, everything except himself, into that power.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Even the followers he brainwashed, the demons and fiends, have vanished and become his strength...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The beings roaming Avalon are merely remnants that wish for this world's destruction, regardless of Weiss.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Think of them as monsters from another world, %s.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea is right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is Weiss trying to do?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: He's made Avalon into a different space, resembling a world he knows. Most likely...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He intends to... connect them.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes. We cannot know what will happen, but Deimos will be at its center.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We have to stop him.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That's why we're all here. Including you...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Frozen and Ren are patrolling now. They promised to tell us if they discover anything. In the meantime, go greet Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. But over there... Is that a giant dragon? How did I miss something so huge?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You can see the dragon now? That's Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're growing accustomed to this space, %s. That's why you can see him now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow...
(Atkina seems to be saying something to %s.)
(But an unknown power carried in his voice pierces their ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh! My ears...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ziskad, we'd better hurry over to Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes. Get them there quickly so it can be settled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, all right... See you later, Ziskad.

steps.name: Avalon Trembles
steps.objective: Defeat [Accidental Gamaliel] and [Apple Tariel] in 「Avalon」. Then turn in the quest to [Ren] in 「Avalon」.

lines.text: (A gigantic dragon with jewel-bright eyes sits deep within the Burning Wheel, watching a path that leads somewhere beyond.)
(Seeing the two approach, he turns his gaze toward them.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's been a while, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah! Lord Atkina! My ears feel like they're tearing apart! It hurts!
(Atkina nods in sudden understanding. When he speaks again, the force bearing down on %s vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that's... That's better now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's been so long since I spoke to anyone in this form that I forgot to control it.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Shynic, Ziskad, Valdrick, and Io were unaffected. I assumed you would be, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you saying?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That I'd been waiting, and was glad to see you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So that's what it meant.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: What you hear is the language of the ancient Pluton dragons. We call it Dragon Speech.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: With a little adjustment, I've made it possible for you to hear my words.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Long ago, the Pluton dragons pooled their power to conceal their speech from the ears of the unworthy.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Think of it as a kind of encoded signal.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Only Lady Seres and those she permits can hear it. You can because you are with Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Otherwise, listening to it any longer might have shattered your mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'm glad I'm alive.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Haha. Indeed... Medea, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I wasn't asking about Dragon Speech...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In that case, you needn't worry.
(Medea smiles faintly.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I see. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then I'll take my place. %s, I'll leave you to speak with Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm? Oh, yes. Of course.
(As Medea says farewell and leaves, Atkina quietly lifts his head and looks into the air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A door has opened in Avalon. The door Weiss made is letting power from another world flow through.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You may not feel it yet, but I can, so close to the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should we do?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Go through the door to Avalon and find Frozen and Ren. With this happening, they won't be able to return here.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm guarding this place so the power of binding doesn't reach the Debora Snowfields. Don't worry too much about us.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Once their work here is finished, the others will go after Weiss. I'll remain. Don't push yourself; find Frozen and stay with him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The goddess is working to keep the wall from collapsing, too. We must all see this through.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Go well.
(It is difficult to read the dragon's expression, but Atkina's familiar, kindly smile comes through.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Through that door, then? I can feel something sinister outside...)
(As %s disappears from the Burning Wheel, Shynic comes racing over from afar.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Old man!! Something's happening outside, isn't it?!
(She trips, apparently catching her foot on a wheel on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I keep telling you to be careful. You'll fall if you run like that...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm not a child! I'm fine! No... Am I really fine?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Shynic...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Don't worry. You have done nothing wrong. None of it was your fault to begin with.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thanks, old man.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I've done all sorts of things, wanting to be forgiven. But everyone died, so no one could forgive me. Sigh... Nothing to be done about that...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So now I'm going to do something I won't need anyone's forgiveness for. That's all right, isn't it? ♡
(Beyond the dark passage lies the familiar air of Eastland, unlike the Burning Wheel.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks just like the vision I saw before coming here.
(Through the thick sandy haze, buildings and homes suggest what must once have been an enormous city.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there really nothing here now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing... Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-it's suffocating. I can still move, but this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it binding?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina said to find Frozen and someone named Ren. I'd better hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But which way? This place is enormous. I need to know where they are...
(Just then, a woman's battle cry rings out from somewhere nearby.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whose voice is that?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure where she is, but I'd better hurry. She could be in danger...

steps.name: Sword of the Shining Star
steps.objective: Defeat [Green-Beaked Harab] and [Gha'agsheblah of Destruction] in 「Avalon」. Then turn in the quest to [Frozen] in 「Avalon」.

lines.text: (In an Avalonian dead end, a woman dressed as a Battle Lord is surrounded by monstrous beings.)
Phew! Herding you all the way here was hard work. I've confirmed that none of you are living creatures of Eastland. In that case...!
(As soon as she finishes speaking, she draws and swings her sword. A wave of sword energy annihilates the otherworldly beings before her.)
Whew...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Ren?
Y-you startled me! How long have you been standing there?
Are you %s? My master told me about you. Please, just call me Ren. It's nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A former temple ascetic who's also the Sword Master's disciple... An unusual background.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: You must be wondering why I wield a sword instead of a magic rod.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The thought did cross my mind.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I was originally an ascetic at the temple, but circumstances brought me to Eastland. There I met my master and became his disciple.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Were you attacked on your way here? You look a little tired...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A little, but I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: No, you're not. Could you turn around for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm? Oh, all right... Wait, why are you pointing your sword at me?!
(Ren draws her sword and sweeps it across %s's back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaagh! That hur... Huh?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? It doesn't hurt at all. I actually feel lighter.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I'm glad. That's what my sword does.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: My style is a little different from Yuran's, or Ull and Ell's. My divine power manifests only through my sword.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's incredible. Just as I'd expect...

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: If you feel unwell while you're here, come straight to me. I'll give you as thorough a slashing as I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... I'll be sure to take care of myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, Ren... What's happening here? Lord Atkina said a door had opened in Avalon.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Oh, that must be what Frozen meant.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: He said he sensed something sinister further inside and told me to wait here.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I think he went to find that door...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: The sinister beings in Avalon have been increasing in number.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Perhaps the door Lord Atkina mentioned connects to another dimension, leading somewhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss must have made it, right?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: As you know, Weiss is trying to summon Deimos... The preparations seem almost complete, but something is missing.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I don't know what. There's nothing he wants here in Avalon. Only unknown enemies who have come to ruin our world.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: There seem to be several things that look like doors. Huh...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ren, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: That sinister presence is growing stronger. 'Evil' isn't quite the right word for it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better go.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I'll come with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know where Frozen is, but we need to find him quickly.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I'll guard you. Visibility is poor ahead, so be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks. I'm counting on you.

steps.name: A Door Made of Books
steps.objective: Defeat [Belosh] in 「Vanitas」. Then turn in the quest to [Frozen] in 「Avalon」.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You fool! You cast aside your faith only to end up here? Is this the answer you wanted?!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: If this is the path you've chosen...
(Unable to contain his agitation, Frozen is circled by the spirit from his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Sorry, Ruu. I got worked up again, didn't I? I'll try to stay calm.
(Only then does the spirit called Ruu return to Frozen's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: 렌의 목소리
lines.text: Frozen! Frozen! Where are you?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren? Ren! I'm here!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You're here too, %s. Did you have any trouble on the way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, but are you all right, Frozen?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I'm glad nothing happened to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, over there...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, can you feel that alien power coming from over there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a little... Is that where the door is?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: There are two strange doors. One takes the form of a book, the other looks like an ordinary door. Both seem to lead to spaces in other worlds.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I examined both, but I could only enter the book-shaped door.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the ordinary one blocked?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It's half open, but the otherworldly energy pouring out kept me from entering.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: If we could weaken it a little, we might manage...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: What do you say, %s? Want to try?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll do it.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Good. Together, we can solve this. My suggestion is holy power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Holy power?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Some remains beyond the door that looks like a book. We can use it to enter the half-open door.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Wait, Frozen. If there's holy power...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The man who doubted our god is there.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: ...Belosh.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: When a follower of a god loses faith and begins to doubt, their power changes drastically. And Belosh became intoxicated by the power of 'Binding,' until even his mind gave way.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: My abilities didn't work on him.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: When Belosh left the temple, he struck down the ascetics who tried to stop him. Only a few survived, including Ren.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I need to meet him.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren...

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yes, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Go back to where I told you to wait. Keep the enemies from approaching the Wheel.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The beings here can't easily harm you. Trust me, trust yourself, and trust everyone. Just as you always have.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Hold them off until everyone except Lord Atkina comes out.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yes, Frozen. I'll head back now. %s, please take care of him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry, Ren.
(Ren nods and returns the way she came. Once she is gone, Frozen pats %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shall we go, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Champions are coming out?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: They have plans of their own. We can ask them later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Belosh... Why didn't he believe in Iris? And why is he here...?)
(Following the light between the pages of an enormous book, they enter a place filled with warm light, unlike desolate Avalon.)
(In the descending light, they see trees and bookshelves lining the outer walls, filled with countless books.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so bright...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: So this place really exists. I'd only heard of it... %s, I don't think we should touch anything carelessly. Be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Do you know this place?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: At the heart of our order is scripture, the doctrine itself. Its different interpretations reveal different aspects, just as one place can contain many different things...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Another side?)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: There's an interpretation passed down only to the order's senior members... It speaks of a place beyond the Great Wall that records information about every world.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: But I never imagined that information would take the form of books like this...
(Frozen's gentle expression gradually hardens.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It's no wonder Belosh came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like a sacred temple.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, our god isn't here. Be careful. It feels as though someone deliberately scattered this holy aura throughout the place.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Correct!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Get back, %s!!
(Frozen steps forward and deflects a hook flying toward them. More attacks follow, but every one proves useless against him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral!!

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: That fool took every hit, but a Demigod sees right through them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Frozen?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I'm fine. I take it you've met Baral before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: During the trouble in Phobos...

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Doesn't seem that long ago, but it feels like a year. I said we'd meet in Avalon, but I didn't expect this. Good to see you, fool.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Baral, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Looking for something, as my contract requires. I was a little surprised when you suddenly arrived. Or perhaps I should have expected it?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Weiss said only those with divine protection could enter this place. He also said its holiness was a disguise.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Vanitas... was that the name? Weiss said it was a good place to rest...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The name doesn't matter. Weiss has the power of a Champion, which explains how he entered. But how did you get in?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Since the noble Demigod asks, I'll answer.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: The Spirit King's potion seems to work. I drank what Elysion's little sister had, and now I can enter the Demon Realm and other worlds.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elysion is Ell's brother... And that potion...)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I've gotten something out of Weiss with it, too. Other employers owe me plenty as well... No time to chat. I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: By the way, are you looking for what I'm looking for? Then let's see who finds it first!

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Before that impious Demigod's mind collapses!!
(Having said his piece, Baral turns and disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Listen carefully, %s. We must be the ones to finish Belosh. We need that power. We must reclaim what belongs to our god.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: If Baral takes it, he'll put it to some twisted use...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'd better hurry.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The paths look complicated. Baral seems to have gone down the middle, so we'll have to split up.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Whichever path we're on, Ruu will tell us at once if we find Belosh or something happens. Your energy is affecting Ruu now, too.
(Frozen lifts the spirit from his shoulder. Ruu meets their eyes and smiles in greeting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm counting on you, little spirit.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, take that way. I'll go this way. Come on, Ruu.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Frozen.
(Frozen leaves first, accompanied by Ruu.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are things I want to ask Belosh. I'd better find him quickly...
(A path stretches endlessly between trees and bookshelves in the white space. Somewhere along it, an eerie purple light spills out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this light? It feels like someone is deliberately spreading it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Holiness mingled with something sinister...
(A powerful, ominous force suddenly erupts, shattering the enormous bookshelves along the walls.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what's happening?
(A man in purple-stained armor walks slowly from the wreckage. Baral pursues him and hurls a chain, which the man casually knocks aside with his arm.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Damn it! Deflected again?! Why?! Why doesn't it work even once?! It works fine on that fool and everyone else!
Such feeble attacks cannot even scratch me...

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Belosh! Come on, fight me properly!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: To hear my name from the mouth of a wretch like you...
(The man called Belosh raises a broken magic rod, triggering a tremendous explosion.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: All talk, aren't you? Some Demigod you are...
(A bookshelf near Baral collapses, revealing a strange black hole hidden behind it.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Huh? Huh?! What's that?!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Farewell. Never set foot in this world again.
(No sooner has Belosh spoken than another explosion erupts. The impact sends Baral into the black hole, where he vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's the same black hole I saw in Rosengarten. They called it a rift in spacetime...)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: How long have you been there? Did Weiss send you to interfere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belosh? I'm...

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: You! You!! You feel just like that woman.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: The one Lady Seres sought to raise as her successor... Disgusting...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about? You're a Demigod, a servant of a god. Iris has succeeded Lady Seres...

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Silence!! That woman, a god?! That weakling?!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Wait. Are you the one she was always talking about? How does it make sense to wait for someone she's never even seen?
(Belosh stares at %s with an irritated expression.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Why? Why did she become a god? Damn it... A human chosen by a god becomes one? An ordinary, useless human with no power!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: A human created by the same god, just a girl from a slightly different tribe. Why her?!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: How does that make sense? A god should awaken with innate omnipotence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That reminds me of what Dummytos... no, Barbatos said. He looked down on Iris and Lady Gaia, saying gods should have power worthy of the name.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Hahaha! Hahahahaha! Gods truly do as they please. Favoring a human like you, handing out protection on a whim.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Lady Seres, Lady Gaia, and that woman... Every god does whatever they please! Aaaaargh!!
(As Belosh roars in rage, the sinister energy around him surges.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: If you truly bear a god's protection, you should be able to defeat the mighty Belosh. Kill me if you wish to prove yourself. Otherwise, you will die.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: But you won't kill me easily. I am...

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: I am Belosh, the Demigod! An apostle of a god, revered by all!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need your power. Otherwise...

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: My holy power...? Hahaha! Hahahahaha! So you did come to kill me! Did that woman order you to?!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: She won't get what she wants. You'll bleed and die right here...
(With a look of disgust, Belosh gathers unholy energy in his broken magic rod.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no reasoning with you anymore. Do I have any choice...?

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: I'll stain this place with your blood, apostle of a false god!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Hah... hah... You're no ordinary opponent.
(After a long battle, Belosh retreats and assesses %s's condition.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... hah... Belosh. I'll say it again. I didn't come to kill you. To reach Weiss, we need to enter another door, and that requires holy power. So...

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: The fight isn't over. You talk too much...
(Belosh strikes the wall, cracking Vanitas's outer shell. The black hole that swallowed Baral begins to widen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop! You'll send us all into that rift!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: You seem afraid.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Then I'll give you the answer you seek.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: The order wouldn't allow me to question anything. They forcibly confined me, saying I was drunk on the power of binding, that my mind had collapsed.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Damn it! I saved this world with my power, and this is how it treats me? I'm arrogant? They dare condemn me? I was freed from that damned binding! I'm not drunk on it!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: This isn't my fault. That woman accepted her destiny as a god and ruined this world!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop. Just stop...

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: And if I don't, what will you do? Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Here, I have learned the truth. A truth a contradiction like the god's adventurer need never know...
(Belosh raises his broken magic rod toward %s, then suddenly collapses to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Gaaah! Aaaaaaargh!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The power... of binding?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: So the apostle has done what he was told not to, just like the other one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss!!

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Damn you, Weiss!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Struggle all you like, foolish Demigod.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Did you think learning that truth would let you leave...? You believed you could survive by becoming the god of this Vanitas.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about...?

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: Urrrgh...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: This place is destined to vanish for Purgatory... When the boundaries of life and death meet, it will lead to Azrael.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: This is Azrael's Vanitas alone... I have no need for another world's Vanitas. Azrael's truth will descend here...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: ...Are you listening?!
(Weiss shouts toward the rift in spacetime further inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss, who are you talking to? What is...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Oathbreaker, you who sent me here...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I offer you the product of your failed design.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: First Ban, now Belosh... I would have liked to dispose of Lux as well... But there was too little time...
(An eerie force spills from the black hole in Vanitas's outer wall. It forms black arms that seize Belosh's limbs and head.)

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: I have learned the truth.

lines.speaker: 벨로쉬
lines.text: I will not... be devoured... by such... sinister power... Gaaah...
(The black arms become a vast darkness that swallows the foolish Demigod completely, leaving no trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just like when Ban disappeared...)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: %s... You have nothing left to do here.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I sent the foolish Demigod's holy power to the other Demigod who accompanied you. He's still wandering around...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I only brought that Demigod here to buy a little time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never got a proper answer from Belosh!!
(With a contemptuous look, Weiss deflects %s's furious attack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Lingering in this collapsing Vanitas is pointless... Purgatory will open now, and his power will descend.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Whatever you choose, you will not get the outcome you desire. I suggest you don't overexert yourself...
(As Weiss speaks, Vanitas's walls and floor begin to split. In the trembling space, the two slowly lose sight of one another.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss, wait for me there. I will...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Ruu? Frozen? Is he all right? He's over there? Let's go...
(Once %s has vanished into the distance, Weiss addresses an exhausted figure clambering up behind him.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I nearly died, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Whatever happens at the end of this day, I will spare you as promised. You helped deliver my message to the Oathbreaker.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: How very generous. I've worked hard, so now I'm free?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You may work for Daphne now.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Hearing that witch's name from you gives me the creeps... But there's something I want to ask.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: There's another door at the far end of Avalon. What was that thing standing inside, wearing your face?
(Ruu guides them through the bookshelves. Vanitas slowly fades, and Avalon comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're out. Thank you, Ruu.
(The enormous book that serves as Vanitas's entrance remains, but it feels different now.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I still go in? No. I shouldn't go back now. Frozen? Where are you?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s! Ruu! Over here!
(Frozen comes into view, waving. Ruu beams at the sight of him and flies over.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: More to the point... Belosh is dead, isn't he? Or should I say, gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Frozen what happened when you met Belosh.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: %s, there's something I'd like to tell you. May I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: My task was to escort Lady Iris from our order's temple to Lumen. I intended to return to Freios when it was done...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: But as the Deimos cult's activities escalated, I kept watch on Avalon. My attempts to infiltrate it taught me a great deal. Then a new mission arrived from the order.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: To pass judgment on him myself... Belosh's arrogance and doubt toward our god continued, though I thought they would end eventually...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I... see.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You needn't pity me. Perhaps not having to end him with my own hands was a blessing amid the misfortune... Sigh...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: In any case, his untainted holy power came to me. It isn't mine, and I don't intend to claim it for myself.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: ...So I'll use it to open the door where Weiss is waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was that truth Belosh said he'd seen?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Something that doesn't belong to this world, I imagine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May I ask what you learned in Avalon?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Of course. But are you sure you want to hear it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Then...
(Frozen stretches out his hand, and Ruu rises into the sky. A moment later, the spirit returns and circles him, scattering motes of light.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I see, Ruu. Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did Ruu say?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The Champions have left the Wheel and split up. Io and Ren are together now.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shall we join them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: And while we're there, let's have Ren treat us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing serious. I don't really need treatment... Ah, Frozen! Wait for me!

steps.name: A Champion's Resolve
steps.objective: Listen to [Io]'s story in 「Avalon's Other Side」, then turn in the quest to [Frozen] in 「Avalon」.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Thanks to you and the other Champions, Io, I could deal with so many enemies easily. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There's no need. It's only what we should...
(Io looks at the demons and otherworldly beings fallen before her, then suddenly falls silent.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Io? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Well... I'm not sure. It feels like one of the things holding Avalon together has disappeared...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Shall we rest a moment? Though there's no time to rest...

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Are you all right, Io? My sword will make you feel better.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Old Valdrick has been cut ten times already and still ran off to hunt demons, saying he felt wonderful. It clearly works...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But it feels a little strange to me. Oh, over there...

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Frozen! %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ren! Io! Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I'm relieved to see you're both safe, Io, Ren.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Io helped me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's good. Where are the others?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We split up after leaving the Wheel. Frozen, you have something to say?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Yes. Something you and I know, and the goddess's adventurer wishes to learn.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I see. Then... Ren, we're going somewhere quiet to talk for a moment. Please wait here.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Where are you going? Inside the Wheel?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: To Avalon's other side.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Somewhere I can't go, then. I'll wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, how do we reach Avalon's other side? With a snowball, perhaps...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ah, you must have done something with the Debora Snowfields' snow.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, just follow Frozen and me. Before long, you'll see a different Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A different Avalon...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It won't be the perfect Avalon people once called a paradise. But at least those otherworldly beings won't be there...
(After only a few steps behind Frozen and Io, %s sees Avalon change, just as Io described.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this place...
(Shrouded in sandy haze, Avalon is as desolate and lonely as it was when Weiss stood here.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This is Avalon's other side. A perfect place for a brief, quiet conversation. But you've seen it before, haven't you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Io and Frozen about the brief vision you saw in Kali before coming here.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You would have come here eventually, even without that witch's tricks. This place... Well, we should tell you, %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Ziskad must have told you everyone was reduced to the power of binding. To be precise, they became magic stones.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You can think of this whole place as one enormous magic stone. The power produced by the stones is being amplified, calling to the world where the Twisted One resides.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All of them became magic stones?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Stones formed from lives lost over hundreds of years have been gathered into masses and erected throughout Avalon.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I examined the remnants that drifted into the Debora Snowfields. They belonged to the Deimos cult. Organisms made from magic stones... imitations of life, of humans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The soldiers and fanatics of the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos were originally human.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: They were believers who followed Weiss and the god called Deimos. But over time, they were replaced by something else.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: As you know, those were magic stones. Ban and Mara made them using the power Weiss gave them. Made from the power of living things...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You must have seen them. They imitated the Kali tribe in Adrica, and hunted in the Debora Snowfields wearing the faces of our ancestors...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: All organisms made from magic stones. Every life they brought in became another stone. Eventually, even those organisms reverted to stone.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Scattered across Avalon, they seem to have become fuel for summoning Deimos. I suppose a summoning like that would require at least that much...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's why we divided up the power Shynic sealed in the Wheel long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it dangerous?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I can't lie with you looking at me like that, %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We'll be all right. We're prepared.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen... Please stop them...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You have your own sense of justice... If someone tried to stop you now that you've come all this way, would you give up?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, you know us. Don't worry so much. We're using that power to destroy every magic stone scattered through Avalon. The effects should... Hm?
(Before Io can finish, Avalon's landscape trembles as though warping. Voices call to her.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭의 목소리
lines.text: Io! Where are you? Come out!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉의 목소리
lines.text: Io! We're nearly done with the boring part! Come to the door!

lines.speaker: 메디아의 목소리
lines.text: Lady Io, you can come now.

lines.speaker: 지스카드의 목소리
lines.text: Io, meet us there. You too, %s!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Well done, everyone. All of you except Lord Atkina, gather there.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Frozen, when we return, join Ren and defeat the otherworldly beings pursuing us.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Won't you need holy power to open the door?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Leave this to us. Save that holy power for the order and Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, save your strength for Iris, too. Please. We believe in you...
(Io steps close and gently embraces %s. Her warmth seems at odds with someone who commands ice and snow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's go out now. Jump on the count of two.

steps.name: The Key to the Door
steps.objective: Defeat [Sinner Vice] in 「Purgatory Azrael」. Then turn in the quest to [Frozen] in 「Avalon」.

lines.text: (You leap forward after Io into a sand-laden wind that feels different. Back in the Avalon haunted by otherworldly beings, Ren is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We came out somewhere else. I'm still not used to this...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Still, we're near Vanitas, in a relatively safe area.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Frozen, take Ren and guard the way to the Wheel. Old Valdrick cleared the other areas, so the Wheel must be protected.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Then I'll go straight to Ren.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Be careful, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You too, %s. Good luck, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you.
(As Frozen hurries toward Ren, Io gives %s a light pat on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Everyone is waiting inside. Let's not keep them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I want to see for myself what Weiss calls Purgatory...
(They enter the strange door leaking sinister energy, and the sight within captures everyone's attention.)
(Dazzling light pours over lifeless ruins. Above, a white staircase stretches through the clouds toward somewhere unseen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Purgatory...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Somewhere here, there must be a path to those stairs climbing into the sky. Weiss will surely be there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Oh, Io. Over there...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What is it? What's over...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Weiss...
(Io meets the eyes of a familiar figure and smiles coldly. The chill flowing around her stops, then sharpens into slender icicles.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What luck. We can settle this right here.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What are you saying...? What is that supposed to mean...?
(The icicles around Io fly at Weiss's chest. But they pass through him and shatter against a distant building.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh! My ears... Just like when Lord Atkina spoke...)
(Every word from Weiss's mouth carries a force that stabs into %s's ears like an awl.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Speak the language of humans, not gods! Deimos!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: D-Deimos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It definitely isn't Weiss. But that power of binding...)
(The being with Weiss's appearance, addressed as Deimos, nods lightly.)

lines.speaker: 데이모스?
lines.text: Forgive me, children who follow Seres.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He looks like Weiss, but he isn't. If this is Deimos... Has the real god descended?)

lines.speaker: 데이모스?
lines.text: You doubt me, and that is understandable. The unease you feel comes from the magic stone in which I am imprisoned.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I am the one you know as a Twisted One. More precisely, a fragment of Deimos... I know it was not you who woke me from my slumber.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: It must have been the one you call Weiss.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: When the chaos you call the Beast annihilated gods and Twisted Ones in this world, the brothers Deimos and Phobos left, as others did.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: They once loved this place. But before such overwhelming terror and helplessness, they, too, had no choice but to leave.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: There were those like Seres, and those who fell into other worlds.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: They promised never to return. Nor did they intend to.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: For a brief moment, we heard a call from the lives we had loved. Phobos sent a fragment of himself to investigate.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: That fragment never returned. Overwhelmed by the magic stones' energy, it became someone's servant.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Deimos also heard the call of the lives he once loved. To investigate, he sent me, his fragment.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: He did not expect me to be captured. Trapped like this in a magic stone disguised as Weiss...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Is that all a Twisted One like you can do?

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I am merely part of the whole... The power of the lives Weiss used to summon me surpassed my own.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Now this stone will transmit my power to him. Then it will summon fragments of Deimos from other times and places.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Deimos has more fragments than this world has spirits.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: If they pierce the Great Wall and arrive here, even Deimos, who has no wish to return, will be compelled to answer the power of the lives Weiss has gathered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A divine being forced to act against its will...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Surely you know. The divine beings who loved this place are not so different from you...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I will sever my connection to Deimos, to delay the arrival of the other fragments as long as possible...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: ...And as always, you are someone the gods would cherish...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: You are...
(The fragment of Deimos gradually hardens and falls silent. Only a mass of magic stone in Weiss's shape remains.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Just as the fragment said...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I can feel the Twisted One's power flowing further inside. To Weiss, no doubt. Are fragments like souls? They seem to enter magic stones, then move elsewhere...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That must have been what happened to the demon Veled. Feta told me the Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau worked on transferring magic golem souls.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait. What about the little Degos I met in the cave near the Mercenary Camp...?)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't dwell on it now. The other Champions are already searching for Weiss. We have to go, too. Hurry!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Yes. Deal with what's in front of me first. I can think about that later...)
(The otherworldly beings the adventurer defeats turn into purple flames and flow deeper into Purgatory.)
(Following that energy leads to the Champions confronting a transformed Weiss. The fight is one-sided: he repels them effortlessly.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hah... hah...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Cough, cough... Shynic, fall back. I'll go next...
(Shynic barely manages to stand, leaning on her scythe.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ziskad, if you die, that's it! Medea! Keep them back and heal them. That idiot and I will manage until Io comes.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Understood. Ziskad, over here!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Valdrick, can you do this?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'm fine. But why isn't Weiss attacking?
(Suddenly, a long, sharp icicle flies at Weiss. He reaches out to deflect it, but it splits into fragments that pierce his arm.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Now that I've taken the fragment of Deimos's power, all of this feels so tiresome.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Is everyone all right? %s and I are here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all okay? That's Weiss over there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why isn't Weiss doing anything...?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: To have to deal with such insignificant creatures...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait. His expression just changed a little.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone, be careful!
(Weiss raises his spear, and an enormous explosion erupts around him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This power...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...It isn't the power I knew Weiss to possess.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Part of the Twisted One Deimos's power is flowing into him.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Doesn't matter. We'll beat him before it gets there. We've got the power the little girl gave us, and together...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Sir Valdrick, don't underestimate...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: He was waiting. For us all to gather... Everyone, get back!
(As Weiss opens his mouth, a vibration of unknown power reaches the Champions. They try to retreat at Shynic's warning, but their movements stop.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Why are Deimos's words coming from Weiss's mouth...?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why is he speaking the language of gods? And even so, why can't we move?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The fragment of Deimos has stopped our time...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...Then that means...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s! %s!! Are you all right, %s?
(Amid their confusion, %s vanishes and reappears, attacking Weiss. He blocks the strike.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: ...You are indeed a suitable key.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this key?!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A soul buried in eternity, now awakened...
(As Weiss speaks, an enormous door wrapped in chains descends from the sky. It is shut tight, secured by a massive lock.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no idea what you're talking about... Why am I...?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You will open this door. Everything will become the Azrael we desire, and salvation will come. Over it, Deimos will rise again as a new god...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then the other gods...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Will cease to exist...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No! I won't let that happen to Iris...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The fragments of Deimos are arriving, little by little... Today has brought your soul closer to becoming a perfect key. I shall take it...
(An unknown barrier forms around Weiss and %s, while the force restraining the Champions releases them.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You who could not even become keys, watch from there and savor your helplessness...
(The Champions move to attack Weiss, but the barrier blocks them completely.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: We can't even lay a finger on him...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'll put all my strength into cutting through that barrier. Everyone, lend me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ziskad, touching it may endanger %s. For now, we must trust our adventurer and watch.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There's still plenty we can do. Look over there. Heading toward Weiss...
(All the Champions turn toward the same spot at once.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Fragments of Deimos and beings from other worlds. We must stop them from coming, keep them from reaching Weiss.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Let's do everything we can...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I never want to regret anything again.
(Awakened by Deimos's power, Weiss relentlessly attacks the one who would become his key. His target endures as best they can, searching for an opening.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Persistent...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... hah...
(Weiss approaches %s, who can barely remain standing, and levels his weapon.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I will pierce your heart and make a key from your blood...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris...)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A being loved by this world's god, a key made from that being... It will suffice. To save my world, Azrael...
(An ominous force streams from Weiss's hand toward %s. Suddenly, a tremendous power rides the wind through the barrier and hurtles at Weiss.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It pierced the barrier...?
(Startled, Weiss dodges. But the power turns back toward him and immobilizes him.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Guh... Gaaah!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: ...Bound by the power of binding myself...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Deimos...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A fragment of Deimos...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I am one of his many fragments. I have severed the connection between Deimos and the Agasura seeking to exploit his fragments' power.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: He never wished to come here this way. Nor did I. I never wished to see the lives I loved like this.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I came because the lives of this world called to me. That was all...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: You made a mockery of me. I answered your call, and you turned me into a hopelessly foolish, twisted being.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Is that it? You ruined so many lives merely for that...?
(Fragments pass through gaps in the solid barrier, gathering into an eerie shadow.)

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: That old man takes the fate of stars too lightly. That is why he keeps creating beings like you and sending them here.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: This star was protected by lives the gods abandoned. And there were gods who lived for those lives. I may not be their equal, but for their sake...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: I will sever the contract between you and that old man, even if it exhausts the fragments' power...
(The shadow formed by the fragments begins to break apart. With each piece, Weiss's body, which used Deimos's power, also crumbles and vanishes.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Aaaaaaargh!!

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: This is a fraction of the pain you inflicted on this world. The terror of chaos and the abyss the old man hurled at my brethren when he sought to destroy this world... Feel it. The annihilation they felt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...The Demon King...)

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Weiss, the world you knew no longer exists. Only an Azrael changed into something else remains.

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Gaia. In the human Seres chose, I saw this star's past and future. Forgive me...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: Now I will disappear. I will not appear again. At least, not in this world, in this form...

lines.speaker: 데이모스의 편린
lines.text: And I leave this man's end to you.
(Before anyone can reply, the shadow that was Deimos's fragments seizes the door that appeared with Weiss. A moment later, door and shadow shatter together, vanishing without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Weiss...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Cough, cough... I only wanted to save Azrael. So I decided to believe that man's words...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The contract was against me from the beginning. A body that could do nothing but sin...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I believed all I had to do was make magic stones from the power of living things. For Azrael, he said. For my world, I... I...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: At some point, I began doing it for myself rather than Azrael. Turning this land's lives into magic stones...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can't use this world for the sake of your own...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I merely thought a world doomed to perish might as well serve Azrael...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: If I were born again, I would do the same...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, may I finish this? ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Shynic...? How did you... Oh, because of the fragments...
(The barrier has disappeared, unnoticed. Shynic steps in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't want you to dirty your hands. If someone's hands must be dirty, let mine be dirtied once more.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The others didn't stop me. I asked them to let me do it. Sigh... They'll be waiting where Frozen is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...
(Shynic smiles brightly and taps %s's shoulder, then looks at Weiss, suffering in his bonds.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Weiss. The gods of this world you mocked, and their power. I happen to have some left. I'll give it all to you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You should never have come here. And you should never have made me like this.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I... I... I don't want to kill anymore! But just once more... I'll end it with you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You must suffer. You have to.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So I'll give you the gift Perse left me. Can you hear the bitter resentment of souls that couldn't even reach the Underworld?
(Shynic swings her scythe with both hands. Black spheres pour from a tear that seems to slice through spacetime and race toward Weiss.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So die.
(The black spheres pierce Weiss's body, then cling to it.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Urgh... Even so, I have no regrets... I only long for that place I can never return to...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Longing for a happier time long ago is regret.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Goodbye, then.
(The black spheres gather into an enormous blade and pierce the still-smiling Weiss's heart. Purple flames consume what remains of his body.)
(Thus the evil that devoured Eastland's lives is swallowed by its own purple flames and an unknowable darkness, and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A hero devoured by darkness...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Weiss? Who were you...?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, I lost something here. Wait where Frozen is. I'll be out soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go together. I can help you look.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No. You wouldn't be able to find it. Only I can...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...All right. But come out quickly. We don't know what will happen to this place...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I will...
(Once %s leaves the place where everything seems to have ended, Shynic looks around, alone.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Weiss, I don't like you, even at the very end.

steps.name: A Hole That Swallows Everything
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Dragon Atkina] in 「Burning Wheel」.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ah, %s... Thank goodness. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. You're all here. Nothing happened, did it?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: No, nothing. The divine power and Avalon's binding have disappeared, so Weiss must be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, where's Shynic?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She said she'd find something she lost and come out.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: She lost something? Hmm. All right.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Let's wait a little. She'll be here soon.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I wanted to finish him myself...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ziskad, Io... As soon as I return, I'll report this to the sanctuary and the order.
(Ruu disappears, and a black light rises through the distant sandy haze.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That black thing... No, surely not.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Sir Valdrick, over here! It's exactly what you think!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: A rift in spacetime...?!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic is in danger. Shynic! Everyone, go on ahead...
(Medea hurries toward Purgatory's door, but Ziskad stops her.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea, calm down and listen. Shynic will be all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, we're all in danger if we stay here.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Trust Shynic, and trust us. Focus on getting back to the Wheel. She'll know it's safe there and come to us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's do that, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
