lines.text: Ruu, find Ren where she's waiting and tell her to go to the Wheel!
(Ruu, circling Medea as though worried about her, hears Frozen and flies straight into the sky.)
(Even while preparing to return to the Wheel, Medea cannot look away from the growing rift. At last, Io taps Valdrick on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What is it, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Old man, put Medea on your shoulder. Quickly.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Io, what are you...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If we don't, I think she'll run over there... I'll leave her to you.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Right. Hold on tight, Medea!
(Valdrick lifts Medea onto his shoulder with one hand, then runs toward the Burning Wheel faster than ever.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: This will only take a moment.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: We leave it to you, Lord Atkina.
(Atkina beats his wings and slowly rises into the air, watching the black hole approach the Wheel.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Absolute One. This world is not as weak as you imagine.
(The jewel on Atkina's forehead shines brightly. Blue light swirling around him gathers in his chest.)
(The powerful dragon's unrestrained roar goes on and on, shaking the Wheel.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Everyone, hold on! The floor might give way!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right!!
(Suddenly, Atkina's eyes turn red. The power gathered in his throat erupts as an enormous blast of dragon breath.)
(The black hole twists the moment the dragon's breath touches it. A sound unlike anything of this world torments them, then fades.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That was...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Cough, cough...
(Once the black hole has vanished, Atkina slowly descends, coughing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's been so long since I used my power that controlling it was difficult. Cough, cough... Age catches up with us all...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The rift has vanished without a trace.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: An ancient Pluton dragon indeed! Lord Atkina, that was magnificent.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: He's on a whole other level.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Lady Iris helped me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: She restored part of the fractured Great Wall and lent me that strength.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: We must thank the goddess.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The otherworldly beings in Avalon seem to have vanished into that hole... But...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic... I can't feel Shynic's presence...
(Medea's legs suddenly give way, and she sinks to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...What were you trying to find? Why didn't you come with us, Shynic...?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: No. Surely not...

steps.name: Savior of Eastland
steps.objective: Finish everything in 「Burning Wheel」, then go to the front of [Galette]'s shop in 「Gerda」. Then talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」.

lines.text: (Atkina senses Shynic's presence and inhales. Shynic rises into the air, barely having held onto the broken floor.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I nearly died, but it was rather fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, how can you say that after such danger...? Sigh... Still, thank goodness you're safe.
(Shynic lands lightly and stretches. Everyone watching her sighs in relief.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You had us worried, little girl.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'm glad you enjoyed yourself...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Shynic, I told you not to wander into danger. Yet you've done it again.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Honestly, you old men... Still treating me like a child.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Are you all right, Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. Look. Every joint cracks when I stretch, but I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: An ordinary person would have been sucked into the rift... What on earth did you go looking for?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A secret. ♡

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Nothing dangerous, I hope?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No, nothing like that.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: You're not in good condition, Shynic. Let me cut you. For you, a hundred slashes should do it...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No thanks. I think I'd die...
(The changed tone of words Shynic would normally say in jest makes Medea realize something. She approaches carefully and takes both her hands.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The power of Perse you shared with everyone here... It was your power to overcome death.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, you truly put your life on the line this time...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Shynic, when you said you had something to give us and made us take our places... I suspected as much. But even so...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I didn't want to be the only one who survived. That power would help everyone here... Better them than me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Don't say things like that. That you're going to die, or that you nearly died...
(As Shynic turns away, unable to speak, Medea pulls her into an embrace.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't...
(Seeing the two, Io runs over and hugs them both.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: My master would've been so happy to see this. I wish she could. To see this fool working together with so many people...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'm sure she's watching from above. I feel as though the work I've done all these years has finally reached its end.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Master...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Well done, everyone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's really over... So much has happened since I met you all in Eastland.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What's this? You sound like you'll never see us again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course not. I'm sure I'll need plenty more help from you. There's still so much left to do...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Just say the word. Wherever you call, little sibling, I'll come running and tear things up. But sparring is mandatory.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well done, %s.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm hungry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Goodness! Lord Atkina is hungry! Then let's all go to our village. There's plenty of food waiting. Everyone, come!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I was hungry too. Perfect timing. Meat! Meat!

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: It really feels like all our hard work is finally over, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It does...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Oh, everyone. As we agreed earlier, Avalon will be managed by the Alliance of Light and a branch of the Seres Order.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The disappearance of the rift doesn't mean our work is done. We must purify this land and make it a home for life again.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Lord Atkina will handle part of the purification in his dragon form.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Lady Gaia has given her permission. I'll visit my homeland briefly, then stay here. I don't know how long it will take, but we'll make it like Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, I haven't seen Lady Gaia at all lately...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Frozen, there's no death power left in the Wheel. I'll leave it to you, too. Definitely not because it's a hassle. ♡

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Thank you. The order was considering opening a new passage, so you've saved us the trouble.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Master.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: What is it, Ren?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Just this once, I'll turn a blind eye if you have a drink. I won't tell Yuran.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Hahaha! Thank you. Come along, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's really over. Really...)
(Io quietly approaches, takes %s's hand, and draws them into an embrace, gently patting their shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't worry too much. You'll do well from here on, too. You accomplished all this with good people beside you, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And don't forget that we were among those good people.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Everyone will slowly move beyond their memories of binding. They'll live dreaming of another future. Thank you for giving us that future.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll spend the rest of my life for everyone's sake, and for Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Io... Everyone...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You have quite a range of expressions, %s. Even that deeply moved look.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: At first, you only looked silly. ♡

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahahaha! Who cares if we're fools? Let's go eat meat! Meat genius!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Come on, then. To our village's Snowflower Inn!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Gerda... What a beautiful place.
(As Medea looks around Gerda with interest, Io beams with pride.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Isn't it? Isn't it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I've told Galette everything. Go inside and wait just a moment, everyone.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Haha! This place really does have the best meat!

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: ...What a delicious smell. I must have used a great deal of strength if I'm craving food.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You've worked hard, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hardly. You all did the work.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ren, thank you for everything. Rest in Eastland for a while and find something you'd like to do.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I will. I was planning to stay in Gerda a little longer anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Everyone looks happy. Because our work in Eastland is finished...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why do I feel so empty...?)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Oh, Goddess? Good to see you! Come eat meat with us!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?
(Turning around, you find Iris standing before the Champions and their companions, looking a little awkward. No one noticed her arrive.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello, everyone.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It's been a while, Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Lady Iris!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Goddess, is it something fun? Take me along if it is. ♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, show the goddess some respect.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't be like that, Medea. I'm making an effort in my own way.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's quite all right, Medea, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is something wrong, Lady Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I think I need to borrow the adventurer now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Iris... I mean, Lady Iris. You have business with %s, then. Get ready to go.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Goddess... We've only just met. I'd be so sorry to see you leave already.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (Lady Iris came because...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll come visit Gerda again. Please don't be too disappointed.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Please do come back.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, close your eyes and take my hand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.
(The moment Iris and %s touch hands, a mysterious light surrounds them and carries them away.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then I'll eat my little sibling's share of the meat, too.
(After seeing the two off, the Champions head into the Snowflower Inn. Shynic gently stops Medea, who is entering last.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, um...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I have something for you...
(Shynic takes something from inside her clothes and places it in Medea's hand.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A Tear of Illusion I found in Purgatory. I thought you should have it. Weiss seems to have made it through a contract with the rabbit witch...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Open your eyes, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad everything in Eastland is over... But I feel empty somehow... Sorry. I didn't mean to be like this...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's all right. I...
(Iris approaches carefully and gently embraces you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So warm...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I understand you, %s. Just as you understood me...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When everyone's strength comes together through trust to accomplish something great... And when something else comes afterward... I still remember that feeling. I can't forget it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That uncertainty about what to do next...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But with time, I began to feel a little better.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You'll feel better with time, too, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will everything be all right? It will, won't it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Let's find our way together. I'll stay with you until it is. Just as you did for me...
(Iris smiles brightly and takes both your hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris... I feel better now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But you brought me here because you have something to tell me, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think I may have a clue to that feeling you've had, %s... That's what I wanted to tell you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She said she would be going somewhere for a little while, then disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did she go...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I've been searching for her, but one thing is certain. She isn't in this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I'm continuing to follow the Great Wall... I'm sure she'll send us a message.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I'll rest a little, then look for something else I can do for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are things I want to ask Lady Gaia, too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. I want to see her again as well. I'll send you back to Gerda now.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: See you later, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris... Take care.
